name: Cofoe Medical Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Cofoe Medical Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sales, and service of home care medical devices in China. The company offers medical and wellness products for various types of diseases treatment, damage therapy, daily health maintenance, and life quality improvement.
